data.name: Ichor Online
data.detailed_description:
An Action MMORPG inspired by the classics. Explore, craft, and grow in a player-driven economy.

Build your character with deep skill trees, party up with friends, and explore a dense, hand-crafted open world with classic RPG freedom—no quest markers, no hidden subscription fees, and no pay-to-win.

  • A world built for discovery. Learn from landmarks, environments, enemies, and the things you find rather than following a checklist of map icons.

  • Adventure alone or with others. Cooperation matters right off the bat, not only in the endgame, but won’t stop you from enjoying the lone wolf path. 

  • Precise, weighty combat built around timing, positioning, dodging, and reading your enemies.

  • Build your own adventurer through attributes, class skill trees, randomized loot, affixes, sockets, and special effects.

  • A dense, hand-crafted world filled with secrets, dungeons, roaming bosses, dynamic events, and discoveries the game won't point out for you.

  • Classic Sandbox RPG exploration with no handholding. No quest markers, glowing trails, or painted paths telling you where to go.

Buy Ichor Online once and play as much as you want. No hidden subscription fees and no pay-to-win.
